notes: Obsidian vault (Settings → 📓 Obsidian vault): pick your vault folder and the app keeps a permanent record of every story there as Markdown. Each character gets a note with all their memories (by day), their relationships and how they feel about you. Every in-app day gets a journal note with your scenes, what happened elsewhere, gossip and who came to you, plus a Story so far note. Names are linked, so Obsidian's graph view shows your whole cast.
The vault is a record only: the app never reads it back, so editing a note doesn't change what happened. Works in the desktop app and in Chrome or Edge on a computer.
Old memories are no longer lost: once a story passes 1,500 memories, the oldest move to an archive, and characters still recall them when something in the scene brings them up.
